prs.title: perf: resolve CLI file filters once instead of per test file
prs.author: maschwenk
prs.body:
`filterTestFiles` runs `relative()` and `toLocaleLowerCase()` on every filter for every test file. none of that depends on the test file, so now it happens once per filter. matching doesn't change

`vitest list --filesOnly` with 800 file paths in a 12k-file project: 23.9s on main, 0.69s with this. also added test cases for an uppercase filter and a path relative to cwd when cwd isn't the root

prs.title: fix(pool): terminate stuck orphaned forks workers
prs.author: AriPerkkio
prs.body:
Fixes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11915

Adds a new watchdog process that's spawned **once** by main process when `forks` or `vmForks` pools are used. Process ID of each spawned `forks` runner is passed to the watchdog. If main process is forcefully terminated, it won't close the pool. Watchdog notices this via `disconnect` event and terminates all test runners with `SIGKILL`.

This is mainly for the use case of https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11915 where infinite synchronous loops could block the test runner. But it's also good generic improvement, as it makes sure orphan workers are never left hanging.

```
  Vitest main               vitest-watchdog              forks worker
       |                           |                           |
-- Normal run -----------------------------------------------------------
       |                           |                           |
       |-- fork() -------------------------------------------->|
       |-- fork() 1st time ------->|                           |
       |-- watch(pid) ------------>|                           |
       |                           |                           | runs tests
       |<------------------------ exit ------------------------|
       |-- unwatch(pid) ---------->|                           |
       |  Pool.close()             |                           |
       |-- disconnect() ---------->|                           |
       |                           |  no PIDs left
…(truncated)
